jobs.text: Tagore wrote the words and tune of Amar Shonar Bangla in 1905, and its first ten lines became the national anthem of Bangladesh in 1972. He also wrote the words of India’s national anthem. He founded a school, Santiniketan, where children learned outdoors, and he wrote more than two thousand songs known as Rabindra Sangeet.

jobs.text: Nazrul served as a soldier in the First World War, became a journalist, and wrote for the equality of Hindus and Muslims. The British imprisoned him for his writing. An illness in 1942 took away his speech and memory, and in 1972 the government of Bangladesh brought him to Dhaka, where he lived until his death in 1976.
